question: Who will co-host the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The United States of America (USA)**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In a first, the USA will host a global cricket competition - the T20 World Cup in June 2024.
 
• The event will be co-hosted with the more established cricket nations of the West Indies.
 
• This will be the first-ever global event hosted in North America. &l
